claim: UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks block by returning hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision set to "deny".
skillListingBudgetFraction defaults to 0.01, reserving 1% of the context window.

The concurrency limit that binds a fan-out first is CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TOOL_USE_CONCURRENCY, whose default is 10 and which gates subagents as well as read-only tools — not the 20-subagent CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS cap.
A SubagentStop hook has no access to the subagent final message and must parse the transcript to get it.
--max-budget-usd works in print mode only, so it cannot cap the spend of an interactive session.
Ctrl+X Ctrl+K stops all running background subagents in the session, and must be pressed twice within 3 seconds to confirm.
A PreCompact hook can inject context into the session across the compaction by returning systemMessage and additionalContext.
Sixteen hook events are marked "Can block? Yes" in the hooks reference exit-code-2 table.
There are five permission modes and the default one is named "manual".

With ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH unset, Claude Code defers all MCP tools by default; setting it to auto loads them upfront when their definitions fit within 10% of context, so auto reduces deferral rather than increasing it.
A SubagentStop hook receives agent_id, agent_type, agent_transcript_path and last_assistant_message, so it can read the subagent final response without parsing a transcript file.
A Stop hook cannot read the session tool history, so it cannot tell whether the tests were run.
A UserPromptSubmit hook can add context to the conversation by returning hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext, and UserPromptSubmit is on the list of events whose returned context is delivered.
maxEffortLevel has Any file scope — it is not managed-settings-only — and a value of "max" sets no cap.
PreCompact is a logging-only event: a PreCompact hook cannot block a compaction.
CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION was removed in v2.1.224 and is now a no-op; it no longer caps the number of subagents spawned in one session.
